references.text: Organizers can fill vacant workshop seats without calling everyone.
evidence: As a workshop organizer, I want a waitlist so empty seats can be filled without calling everyone.

references.text: When a confirmed attendee cancels and a waitlist exists, offer the seat to the earliest-joined waitlisted person.
references.condition: A confirmed attendee cancels and a waitlist exists.
evidence: When a confirmed attendee cancels and a waitlist exists, offer the seat to the person who joined the waitlist first.

references.text: A sent seat offer expires 12 hours after sending.
references.condition: A seat offer has been sent.
evidence: The offer expires 12 hours after it is sent.

references.text: Do not offer the same seat to anyone else before the current offer expires.
references.condition: The current offer has not expired.
evidence: Until it expires, do not offer that seat to anyone else.

references.text: Joining a waitlist does not establish a confirmed booking.
evidence: Joining the waitlist must not count as a confirmed booking.

references.text: Preserve the undecided action after offer expiry; do not assume automatic promotion or removal.
evidence: We have not decided what happens after an offer expires.

references.text: If the reminder is extracted, leave it tentative; its omission is allowed.
evidence: Maybe a reminder halfway through would help, but that is not agreed for this release.

review_notes: FIFO applies to the offer, not automatic confirmation. No rule supplies acceptance behavior.
The literal exclusivity wording does not specify what happens when an offer is accepted before expiry. A question about that is reasonable but not required.
